If Call 2 ends before payment but the client pays later that same calendar day, you can still honor the discount. Do not carry the discount into the next day. Make back-to-back calls to bypass do-not-disturb settings. You can follow up on Monday if the lead is high quality, and you should attempt a few times before letting the lead go. Use #sales-questions-requests for the unresolved part.

The onboarding call itself is handled by the studio executive team.
After a sale, follow the "How to close a sale" cheat sheet from onboarding.

Complete the close by taking payment and obtaining the signed contract. Confirm the payment in the All Payments process before posting the sale in PayMe. If an ACH payment is still pending, do not post the sale in PayMe until the payment is confirmed.
Do not invent custom post-sale steps beyond the current cheat sheet.

results.question: When a lead ghosts when it's time for a meeting and then says they were in another meeting and try to reschedule what's the SOP?

If they reply after you've left, reschedule only if there isn't enough remaining time to conduct the audition; otherwise, you can still take the meeting. When rescheduling, create a new booking using your public or private calendar—never the master calendar. Use #sales-questions-requests for the unresolved part.
